purpose: Complete decision-time entry/exit economic and protection proofs for four historical round trips without copying or exposing the whole ledger
implementationBoundary: Use the existing privileged maintenance/forensic mechanism and account-preserving read-only snapshot; no service restart, database mutation, reseed, credential reads or new reporting path
journalLookup: Eight exact attempt action_id rows: revision, action_id, at, kind, detail. Read the matching order:<orderId> journal row for each attempt using orderId inside its detail. Include matching actions.result/id rows and validated filled-trade cache records. Export native SOL spend/receive/gas/deposit/refund fields and the exact account revision only; no unrelated private rows.
additionalRequiredProofs: Canonical verified pool and finalized migration chain timestamp available before decision
Independent executed-flow history audit boundaries/completeness and exact 60-second qualification features
Actual-size entry and liquidation quote raw pool-state references, source clocks, quote slot, information availability and modeled delay
Each completed protection evaluation and unavailable check through close, with physical RPC dispatch/response and scheduler deadlines
Run/source/configuration identities and process interruption brackets; original snapshot hashes and collection receipt
missingHistoricalEvidencePolicy: Explicit missing record/path is acceptable; never substitute current pool state, future prices or listener receipt as migration time.
